title: Li Kya Tshong, Former Clerk Of Chinese Post Office Wanted For Embezzlement Of Funds Of Taiyuan Post Office

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

D 44424442
Date 30 / 1 / 33

Crime Memo. No. 8/33.

Headquarters, Crime Branch,
January 30, 1933.

Name ......... Li Hya. Tshong (李家聰)
Native of ... Szechuen
Age .......... 25 years
Occupation .. Formerly a clerk in the
               Chinese Post Office
Build ........ Medium
Hair ......... Cropped short
Complexion .. Pale

The original of the above photograph is wanted
on a Circular Order of Arrest issued by the Shanghai
First Special District Court for having embezzled
official funds of the Fiyuan Post Office.
Any information, please notify Headquarters,
Crime Branch.

CCP²

K. E. Bourne
Deputy Commissioner (Crime)

Hongkew Section, /
Date Jan 21 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
HEADQUARTERS
CENTRAL REGISTER
No. C. 1. 159
Date 21/1/33

Subject (in full) See attached.

Made by D.S.I. Brownrigg. Forwarded by C.D.I. Knight.

Sir,
The undersigned interviewed Mr. Chapelain Postal Commissioner
on the 19-1-33 and ascertained that the offence had not been repor-
ted to the S.S.D. Court, neither had a Circular Order of Arrest been
applied for. Mr. Chapelain was advised that this must be done bef-
ore the S.M. Police could take any action, he agreed and stated he
would do so as soon as possible and would notify the Police when
this had been done.

Knight C.D.I.
Sen. Det. i/c

D. Brownrigg
D.S.I.

D.D.O. "C" Div.

Crime Branch

先生，
具名人于33年1月19日会见了邮政专员 Chapelain 先生，并查明该案尚未向上海特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court）报案，亦未申请签发通缉令。已告知 Chapelain 先生，在上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M. Police）采取任何行动之前，必须完成上述程序，他表示同意，并称将尽快办理，并在完成后通知警方。

No. 17611. POSTAL.
General No. -

ACKNOWLEDGED
POST OFFICE.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
HEADQUARTERS
CENTRAL REGISTRY
No. C. 248
Date 17 / 1 / 33

Sir,

I have the honour to forward to you, enclosed
herewith, eight copies of a notice issued by the Directorate
General of Posts in connection with the arrest of a certain
Li Chia-ts'ung (李家聰), formerly officer-in-charge of
the Parcel Department of the Shansi District Head Post
Office at Taiyüan and who absconded with official funds.
All particulars regarding his age, native, appearance, etc.,
with his photograph, have been given in the notice.

The present whereabouts of this culprit are unknown
and his apprehension is earnestly desired. I shall be
obliged if you will take all possible steps to effect his
arrest and bring him to justice.

As soon as arrest is effected, please inform me
accordingly, so that a report may be submitted to the
Directorate General of Posts for issuing a fitting reward.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

A. M. Chapelain,
Postal Commissioner.

To
The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Cnadat
delish C. O. - 8 April

DEPUTY COMMISSIONER
JAN 18 1933
(CRIME BRANCH)

wishes on D.I.S.

第17611号。邮政。
总编号 -

已收悉
邮政局。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
总部
中央登记处
编号 C. 248
日期 33年1月17日

先生，

谨随函附上邮务总局就逮捕一名名为 Li Chia-ts'ung（李家聰）之人所发布的通告八份。此人曾任太原山西区头等邮政局包裹部主管，携公款潜逃。通告中已列明其年龄、籍贯、外貌等所有详细信息，并附有照片。

目前该罪犯下落不明，亟需将其缉拿归案。如蒙采取一切可能措施将其逮捕并绳之以法，不胜感激。

一旦实施逮捕，请即告知，以便向邮务总局提交报告，发放适当赏金。

谨此致敬，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

A. M. Chapelain，
邮政专员。

致
警察总监，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

Cnadat
delish C. O. - 4月8日

副总监
1933年1月18日
